note: R10 single declared alias map. Declared PER RUN. The kit ships this empty on purpose: an alias map carrying the previous run's module names is the previous run's answer, and a kit that ships last run's answers cannot test anything (README). Fill 'run_id' and 'entries' during SPECIFY, from the neutral spec's own unit ids, before any FULL-tier graph is rendered.

entry_shape.source: mod:<source module name as it appears in the source flow manifest>
entry_shape.target: mod:<unit id as declared in the neutral spec>

order_note: tools/render_graphs.py takes the declared unit order from the order of 'entries'. List them in the order the diagram should read.
